basics.summary: I’m a PhD student working with [Michael Bronstein at the University of Oxford](https://www.cs.ox.ac.uk/people/michael.bronstein/) and [David Baker at the Institute for Protein Design](https://www.bakerlab.org/). I’m also a Senior Machine Learning Scientist in [NVIDIA’s Fundamental Generative AI team](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/genair/), where I work on generative models for protein design.
